newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rise again, spurring buyers.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rise again, spurring buyers.

text.p: ARA bunker prices rose again on Tuesday and concerns over further strength encouraged buyers back into the market, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst rose by another $1/$2 a tonne to $126/$127 fob. Crude's sharp rally on Monday lifted fuel oil barges first thing on Tuesday and some 10,000 tonnes of barges traded.
Subsequent demand in the bunker market was also strong, with around 15,000 tonnes of enquiries, including a couple of larger enquiries from Asian ship operators, dealers said.
"Demand has been pretty reasonable today. I guess people were a bit worried prices will rise further," one supplier said.
Hamburg fuel oil bunkers rose in line with Rotterdam and demand improved, although not dramatically.
Mediterranean bunkers continued their lacklustre course, steady to slightly firm, with little or no demand.
A number of Med dealers said they believed prices would rise later this week, but buyers were clearly prepared to wait.
